title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB (Cosmic Orange) $1799 (RRP $2199) Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 256GB (Cosmic Orange) $1799 (RRP $2199) Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)

[He-Mania] Good price! Maybe OW will price match.
I got this phone when OW were doing skytree price matches and love it! Came from a 16 Pro… I was skeptical yet now prefer the larger size
[jedimaster] officeworks dropped the price to $1799 as well. no more price match.
[botters] Hey all, I need a new phone to upgrade mine and filter down phones though the family. Do you think I should be patient and wait for a better price on iPhone 17 pro at $1699? Or will it likely not drop much more over coming few months?
[DevilsInDetails] I don’t think so. 17 Pro wasn’t a terrible sale at all. The current discount is for clearing whatever’s left, and it’s going fast.
[He-Mania] I suspect this is true.
I usually goes:
New iPhone releases
Apple removes previous models from its stores
Retails put current stock on-sale
If lucky further sales
Stock clears
Only refurbished models available
[TEER3X] Need a deal on the 17 regular model or an iPhone air (that actually ships)
[deniar214] Kogan has set the price at 1723 dollars
Why is no one buying from them. Do officeworks not price match with Kogan.
